assumptions.assumption: Facility structure and primary repayment framing
assumptions.challenge_trigger: Actual borrower, purpose, tenor, repayment source, or facility structure differs from the fictional case.
assumptions.source_claim: $5m 12-month revolving working-capital request; bullet maturity; operating liquidity as primary repayment
assumptions.validation_method: Reconcile executed term sheet, use of proceeds, borrowing-entity forecast, and debt-service schedule.

assumptions.assumption: Four million USDC collateral lot on Base
assumptions.challenge_trigger: Proposed asset, quantity, custody venue, chain, ownership, or accessibility changes.
assumptions.source_claim: 4m USDC on Base at $1.00 in proposed lender-controlled structure
assumptions.validation_method: Verify asset, quantity, beneficial ownership, custody balance, chain, and controlled account.

assumptions.assumption: Collateral stress, execution cost, delay cost, fixed cost, and coverage
assumptions.challenge_trigger: Observed liquidity, execution cost, route timing, fees, or required coverage differs materially.
assumptions.source_claim: 2% price stress; 50bp execution cost; $9800 delay cost; $20000 fixed cost; 1.25x coverage
assumptions.validation_method: Calibrate to approved policy, executable market evidence, route tests, and documented fees.

assumptions.assumption: Illustrative obligor cap and ordinal rating
assumptions.challenge_trigger: Private forecast, debt schedule, liquidity, or operating performance changes the obligor assessment.
assumptions.validation_method: Complete private repayment analysis and independent rating review against approved criteria.

assumptions.challenge_trigger: Policy limit, current exposure, pending commitments, or risk appetite differs.
assumptions.validation_method: Reconcile to current approved single-name policy and live portfolio exposure.

assumptions.challenge_trigger: Portfolio composition, aggregation taxonomy, concentration threshold, or proposed exposure changes.
assumptions.validation_method: Reconcile asset, sector, custody, and route aggregation to current portfolio reports and policy.

assumptions.assumption: Ownership, priority, control, custody, and route requirements
assumptions.challenge_trigger: Any ownership, priority, control, custody, enforceability, or route evidence is missing or adverse.
assumptions.source_claim: Ownership first priority legal control custody and repayment route required before funding
assumptions.validation_method: Obtain executed documents, lien search, legal confirmation, custody evidence, and successful route test.

method_limit: Assumption governance documents ownership and challenge requirements. It does not validate an assumption, convert it into a fact, or establish Coinbase policy.
